geometry: uncentered cosine; same original fixed-cell-line-by-dose cohort and 3000 source-feature-row axis
rsa: average-tie-rank Spearman over matched upper triangle, excluding diagonal; constant geometry NA
relevance: truth top10 excluding self; exact boundary ties split remaining relevance mass equally; sum=10
predicted_ties: expected DCG over uniform ordering of each exact-score tied block
nonfinite_or_negative_mean_policy: stop affected source-dependent analysis, preserve evidence; no silent repair
zero_norm_policy: stop affected group; no cosine-zero substitution or condition exclusion
constant_truth_policy: UNINFORMATIVE_TRUTH, NDCG/random/excess NA; retain original denominator
statistical_scope: one study; 12 dependent groups, two directions not independent replicates; descriptive only
unit: drug condition at fixed cell line, dose and 24h; measurements from original rep1/rep2
exclusions: only original main_eligible=False six YM155 atoms; no reliability-based selection
input_permission: read-only frozen caches and definitions; no raw H5AD, encoding, fitting or new gene selection
independent_qa: independent source-cache reconstruction and all-group metrics; no new producer/helper import; semantic tie/NA fixtures
resource_estimate: CPU single-thread; <2GiB target; one group at a time; not a runtime guarantee
interpretation: repeat-consistency reference, not strict noise ceiling; fixed-dose scope differs from R1 cross-dose groups
r1_preserved_finding: exposure additions improved dose readout and local neighborhoods in all36 dependent records; RSA mixed; do not recast as no response benefit
reference_scope: copy complete_metadata/source_name six-model72 rows and simple-baseline36 rows from12 fixed-dose groups; original pooled-effect truth, not the repeat endpoint; no correction or subtraction
stop_after: R2 results, independent QA, readout; no R3/R1_BROAD/C-lite/prototype/plots/manuscript edits
